prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes.     If object is found, then pick it up. If object is heavy, move it. Perform inspection. Approach or scan.     list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickupObject    /> <Action ID = MoveObjectToDesignatedLocation    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <SubTree ID = PerformObjectInspection    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectFound    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectFound? THEN
			DO PickupObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectHeavy? THEN
			DO MoveObjectToDesignatedLocation
	ELSE
		DO PerformObjectInspection
	END
